thisIsTheControllingAssignmentManifest: One manifest says what is dispatched, and this is it. It replaces first-wave-assignments.json, which was renamed to this path rather than copied, so no second manifest can claim a lane.
twoCommitMethod: Workers branch from captainBaseSha and read this manifest from the dispatch commit that follows it. The base is a constant rather than a lookup, because a manifest that recorded its own commit could not exist before it was committed.
